posts.zh:
dsh-ops-health 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。一键健康检查：侧边栏按钮经纯 HTTP 路由（独立于工具注册表）调用 check-health.ps1 并渲染结构化报告卡片；配色跟随当前主题，Windows/PowerShell。

posts.en:
dsh-ops-health is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. One-click health check for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar button runs the ops kit's check-health.ps1 through a plain HTTP route (independent of the tool registry) and renders a structured report card; colors follow the active theme, Windows/PowerShell.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a2c4bf5caebd3aa02d5c.html
